lead.titleZh: 慢性腰痛：悬吊核心与压力生物反馈训练的疗效对比 RCT
lead.titleEn: Chronic LBP: Suspension Core vs. Pressure Biofeedback Training Efficacy RCT
lead.paragraphZh: 今日我们共发布 9 条更新，覆盖 4 个专科。骨科与肌骨专科有 2 篇 curatedScore 75 分的文献值得关注。其中，一项 RCT 比较了悬吊核心训练与压力生物反馈训练对慢性机械性腰痛的疗效。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's edition features 9 updates across 4 specialties. Notably, two papers in Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal scored 75, with one RCT comparing the efficacy of suspension core training and pressure biofeedback training for chronic mechanical low back pain.

items.title: Client Challenge
items.summary: A three-arm RCT (n=48) found that both suspension core training and pressure biofeedback-guided core training significantly reduced pain and disability in chronic mechanical low back pain patients after four weeks compared to an advice-only control. Suspension core training showed additional benefits over pressure biofeedback in lumbar extension ROM and core muscle endurance, but not in pain intensity or flexion ROM.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性机械性腰痛，与单独建议相比，悬吊核心训练和压力生物反馈核心训练都能在短期内减轻疼痛和改善功能。悬吊核心训练在腰椎伸展 ROM 和核心耐力方面可能优于压力生物反馈，但并非所有结果都一致。
items.titleZh: 悬吊核心训练与压力生物反馈训练对慢性机械性腰痛的疗效：一项三臂随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（n=48）显示，与单独建议相比，悬吊核心训练和压力生物反馈核心训练在慢性机械性腰痛患者中均能在四周后显著减轻疼痛和改善功能残疾。悬吊核心训练在腰椎伸展活动度（ROM）和核心肌耐力方面优于压力生物反馈，但在疼痛强度或屈曲 ROM 上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic mechanical low back pain, both suspension core training and pressure biofeedback core training significantly reduce pain and improve function short-term compared to advice alone. Suspension core training may offer additional benefits in lumbar extension ROM and core endurance over pressure biofeedback, though not consistently across all outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小、干预期短且无随访数据，结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size, short intervention period, and lack of follow-up warrant cautious interpretation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The clinical reasoning associated with prognosis and musculoskeletal disorders - A Masterclass in incorporating prognostic reasoning into physiotherapy practice.
items.summary: This masterclass article outlines a practical framework for physiotherapists to incorporate clinical reasoning associated with prognosis into their management of musculoskeletal disorders, aiming to optimize patient outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本篇「大师班」文章深入探讨了预后判断在骨科物理治疗中的核心地位，提供了一个实用的框架，指导你如何将预后思维融入临床实践，优化患者结局。
items.titleZh: 与预后和肌肉骨骼疾病相关的临床推理——将预后推理纳入物理治疗实践的大师班课程
items.summaryZh: 这篇大师班文章为物理治疗师提供了一个实用框架，旨在将预后相关的临床推理融入肌肉骨骼疾病管理中，以优化患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This "Masterclass" article delves into the core role of prognostic reasoning in orthopedic physical therapy, providing a practical framework to guide you in integrating prognosis into your clinical practice to optimize patient outcomes.
items.limitation: 本篇为专家意见，而非基于原创研究数据。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert opinion article, not based on original research data.

items.title: Sensor-based motion analysis identifies distinct biomechanical recovery trajectories following internal fixation and arthroplasty: a retrospective longitudinal cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=228) using sensor-based motion analysis identified a limited subset of 12 measures with FDR-supported differences in biomechanical recovery trajectories over 200 postoperative days between hip internal fixation and arthroplasty patients. These included balance, gait, chair-stand, kinematic, and patient-reported variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提示，髋关节内固定与关节置换术后早期恢复的生物力学轨迹存在差异。在临床实践中，您可以根据患者的术式和诊断，考虑使用传感器数据来监测其个性化康复进程。
items.titleZh: 髋关节内固定与关节置换术后生物力学恢复轨迹的传感器分析：一项回顾性纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=228）使用传感器运动分析，在髋关节内固定和关节置换术后200天内，识别出12项指标在生物力学恢复轨迹上存在显著差异，包括平衡、步态、起立坐下、运动学和患者自评变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests distinct biomechanical recovery trajectories post-hip internal fixation versus arthroplasty. In clinical practice, you might consider using sensor-based data to monitor individualized rehabilitation progress, tailored to the patient's surgical procedure and diagnosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性探索性队列研究，且未获取康复暴露数据，其发现具有关联性而非因果性，需在诊断特异性队列中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective exploratory cohort study lacked rehabilitation exposure data, making its findings associative rather than causal; external validation in diagnosis-specific cohorts is required.

items.title: Physiatry-physiotherapy interdisciplinary project (PHY 2 ): Service evaluation of a new caregiving model for musculoskeletal pain by advanced practice physiotherapists in the physiatry department.
items.summary: A single-center prospective descriptive cohort study (n=300) found that Advanced Practice Physiotherapists (APPs) independently managed 41% of musculoskeletal pain patients without physiatry consultation, reducing wait times and improving patient satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 对于常见肌肉骨骼疼痛，高级执业物理治疗师（APP）可以独立承担近一半的患者管理工作（41%），并且可以有效缩短等待时间、提高患者满意度。在你的机构中，可以考虑更大力度地授权APP来管理这类患者，提升效率。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗-理疗科多学科项目 (PHY2)：高级执业物理治疗师在理疗科为肌肉骨骼疼痛患者提供新照护模式的服务评估
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心前瞻性描述性队列研究（n=300）发现，高级执业物理治疗师（APPs）独立管理了41%的肌肉骨骼疼痛患者，无需理疗师会诊，同时缩短了等待时间并提高了患者满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Advanced Practice Physiotherapists (APPs) can independently manage almost half (41%) of common musculoskeletal pain patients, effectively reducing wait times and improving patient satisfaction. Consider empowering APPs more robustly in your clinic to manage these patients, which could significantly boost efficiency.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性描述性队列研究，且缺乏对照组，结果推广性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective descriptive cohort study without a control group, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Force and Power Testing in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Literature: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review of 1625 studies on force and power testing post-ACLR identified significant heterogeneity in device selection, metrics, and protocols. Isokinetic dynamometry (64.9%) remained the most adopted testing device, but assessment practices have become more varied, with studies using 1.42 ± 0.62 devices on average.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述揭示了前交叉韧带重建术后力量和爆发力测试方法的显著异质性。在临床实践中，这意味着您在解读不同研究结果时需注意其评估工具和方案的差异，并考虑结合多种设备进行更全面的评估。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建文献中力量和爆发力测试：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对1625项关于前交叉韧带重建术后力量和爆发力测试的研究进行的范围综述发现，设备选择、测量指标和方案存在显著异质性。等速测力计（64.9%）仍是最常用的测试设备，但评估实践已变得更加多样化，平均每项研究使用1.42 ± 0.62种设备。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals significant heterogeneity in force and power testing methods post-ACL reconstruction. In clinical practice, this means you need to account for differences in assessment tools and protocols when interpreting various study results, and consider combining multiple devices for a more comprehensive evaluation.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，侧重于现有文献的总结和描述，未进行质量评估和综合分析。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review focused on synthesizing and describing existing literature, without conducting quality assessment or comprehensive analysis.

items.title: Psychological readiness, active knee flexion and patient-reported knee function at 12 and 18 months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study (n=75) on ACLR patients found that higher psychological readiness (ACL-RSI) was associated with higher concurrent patient-reported knee function (Lysholm score) at 12 and 18 months post-surgery. Active knee flexion increased by 4.00° (95% CI, 3.15°–4.85°; P < 0.001) but was not significantly associated with Lysholm score.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在前交叉韧带重建术后，患者的心理准备状态与患者自评膝关节功能存在正相关。在术后评估中，您除了关注身体功能指标外，还应将心理准备状态纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后12和18个月的心理准备状态、膝关节主动屈曲和患者自评膝关节功能：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对75名前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）患者的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，术后12和18个月，较高的心理准备状态（ACL-RSI）与较高的患者自评膝关节功能（Lysholm评分）相关。主动膝关节屈曲增加了4.00°（95% CI，3.15°–4.85%；P < 0.001），但与Lysholm评分无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a positive association between psychological readiness and patient-reported knee function after ACL reconstruction. In postoperative assessment, you should consider psychological readiness alongside physical function measures.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，样本量小，未建立因果关系，且对随访期间关联差异的评估不精确。
items.limitationEn: This single-center retrospective cohort study had a small sample size, did not establish causality, and its assessment of association differences over follow-up was imprecise.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: [Correspondence] The F-words for Child Development: Lessons Learned
items.summary: The creators of the "F-words for Child Development" framework thank Wilson et al. for their advocacy, fully endorsing the expanded set of ideas regarding disability, which includes function, family, fitness, fun, and future.
items.curatedReason: 这篇通信是对“儿童发育 F 词框架”的再次肯定，它强调了功能、家庭、健身、乐趣和未来等因素在儿童残疾康复中的核心作用。这为你理解以家庭为中心、以功能为导向的儿童康复理念提供了进一步支持。
items.titleZh: 儿童发育 F 词：经验教训
items.summaryZh: “儿童发育 F 词”框架的创建者们感谢 Wilson 及其同事对该理念的推广，并完全认可这一扩展的残疾概念集合，其中包括功能、家庭、健身、乐趣和未来。
items.curatedReasonEn: This correspondence reaffirms the "F-words for Child Development" framework, emphasizing the central role of function, family, fitness, fun, and future in pediatric disability rehabilitation. It provides further support for your understanding of family-centered, function-oriented pediatric rehabilitation concepts.

items.title: Unpacking what works in home rehabilitation in relation to contexts, mechanisms, and outcomes in a qualitative scoping review
items.summary: A qualitative scoping review of 62 studies identified three categories (professional knowledge and approach, home and everyday life, focus on personalization) of contextual factors and mechanisms influencing outcomes in home rehabilitation for older adults. These factors shape resources and reasoning contributing to rehabilitation outcomes from the perspectives of older adults, relatives, and staff.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性范围综述识别了影响老年人居家康复效果的关键情境因素和机制。在设计居家康复服务时，您应关注个性化、专业知识、沟通以及家庭与日常生活的整合，以实现以人为本的服务。
items.titleZh: 定性范围综述：剖析居家康复中情境、机制和结果的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对62项研究进行的定性范围综述识别出影响老年人居家康复结果的情境因素和机制的三个类别（专业知识与方法、居家与日常生活、关注个性化）。这些因素从老年人、家属和医护人员的角度，塑造了有助于康复结果的资源和推理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative scoping review identifies key contextual factors and mechanisms influencing home rehabilitation outcomes for older adults. When designing home rehabilitation services, you should focus on personalization, professional expertise, communication, and the integration of home and daily life to achieve person-centered care.
items.limitation: 本范围综述仅纳入定性研究，未能提供居家康复干预的量化效果或证据等级。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review included only qualitative studies, providing no quantitative effects or evidence levels for home rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Chart-derived frailty index is associated with long-term mortality and longitudinal health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a prospective cohort (n=1072) found that a higher chart-derived frailty index (CFI) was associated with increased mortality (adjusted HR 2.621) and poorer health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults. Exploratory analyses also suggested poorer long-term walking ability and mobility in the high-CFI group.
items.curatedReason: 图表衍生衰弱指数（CFI）与髋部骨折老年患者的长期死亡率和健康相关生命质量相关。在术后康复管理中，您可以利用CFI作为评估工具，识别高风险患者，并可能调整康复计划以改善预后。
items.titleZh: 图表衍生衰弱指数与髋部骨折老年患者长期死亡率和纵向健康相关生命质量的关联：一项前瞻性队列研究的次级分析
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=1072）的次级分析发现，髋部骨折老年患者的图表衍生衰弱指数（CFI）较高者，与更高的死亡率（调整后HR 2.621）和较差的健康相关生命质量相关。探索性分析还提示高CFI组的长期步行能力和活动能力较差。
items.curatedReasonEn: The chart-derived frailty index (CFI) is associated with long-term mortality and health-related quality of life in older adults with hip fractures. In postoperative rehabilitation management, you can use CFI as an assessment tool to identify high-risk patients and potentially adjust rehabilitation plans to improve outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性队列的次级分析，对纵向轨迹差异的证据受模型设定影响，且功能结局分析为探索性。
items.limitationEn: This secondary analysis of a prospective cohort found evidence for different longitudinal trajectories sensitive to model specification, and functional outcome analyses were exploratory.
